Blue Whale Cookie (Korean: 대왕고래맛 쿠키, daewanggorae-mat kuki) is an Epic Cookie released alongside her Pet, Lil' Krill, in the second half of The Lost City's New Future update.

Story[]

Small ripples spread across the surface of the ocean, growing and growing until they reveal a mountainous figure rising out of the once calm sea... but no need to worry! It's just Blue Whale Cookie, searching for any wandering young ones!

Her large form simply holds her even larger heart, with more than enough room to welcome an embrace any who approach her. She lovingly looks after any young Cookies who come to the Conch's Cradle Nursery, whether they be the beloved youngest of a large family or a long young one found wandering in the wide, open sea. This caring Cookie's demeanor and teaching methods have filled the Nursery with the joyful laughter of young Cookies.

Some may ask if it ever gets tiring looking after so many ones, but Blue Whale Cookie simply replies with a calm smile and reminder that even the smallest memories are formative in young Cookie's development. It seems like she's going to willingly be there to block any harsh waves until the Cookies are ready to go out into the world!!

Affection Jelly[]

One of her greatest treasures is a small stone given to her by a temple Cookie when she was young.

Blue Whale Cookie's Skill
Enters the ocean at fixed intervals. Schools of sea creatures surrounded in bubbles appear and swim with the Cookie of you pop the bubbles. While swimming with the Cookie, the sea creatures create Seadrop Jellies and help the Cookie swim faster.Level Up for more points for Seadrop Jellies.

General[]

  • Even the youngest Cookies should be respected.
  • Today we're planting coral! Follow me, two straight lines!

  • Time to practice swimming amongst the jelly fishes(sic)!

  • I hope to make a loving environment for all the little ones!
  • Childhood memories are decisive in how a Cookie grows up...
  • Children's bubbly laughter is a sign of a happy city!
  • Okay, little ones! It's time for a nap!
  • The future of Neo Sugarteara is bright!

Daily Gift[]

  • I hope you had fun today!

Tap[]

  • Good morning, little ones! Did I wake you from sweet dreams?
  • I'm so happy to see all of you again today!

  • It makes me so proud to see you grow up healthy and strong!
  • I'll lead the way until the day you can confidently swim through the world yourselves!
  • Get along with your new friends!
  • New little ones come to the Conch's Cradle Nursery each day as Neo Sugarteara continues to grow!
  • I'm more than happy so long as I'm able to provide a place for these young Cookies to grow.
  • While it may seem like no big deal, it could mean the whole world to a young Cookie!
  • May no young Cookie grow up lost and alone... as I once did...
  • Sleepy night, tucked in tight♪ I'll sing a lullaby so you'll all have the sweetest dreams. (When placed in the Naptime at Conch's Cradle Nursery Lobby)
  • I practiced my smile for ages in hopes it could put Cookies at ease just like yours does. (When placed in a Lobby with Mocha Ray Cookie or Sugartearan Sacred Guardian)
  • I'll let you explore on your own if you come back once you've grown up a bit more. (When placed in a Lobby with Strawberry Crepe Cookie)

Changelog[]

  • The Legend of the Spirit Weapons - August 28, 2025
    • Fixed issue where sea creatures failed to keep up during overlapping Blasts with skill activations.
  • The Lost City's New Future - August 13, 2025
    • Added to the game as a playable Cookie alongside a Costume, Sweet Summer Dreams.
  • The Lost City's New Future - July 28, 2025
    • Appears in the The Lost City's New Future story.

Trivia[]

  • Abyss Monarch Cookie's relationship chart can be unlocked by placing Blue Whale Cookie in the Naptime at Conch's Cradle Nursery Lobby Design.
